name: multistorey-interactions-f13
description: v0.31.5.382 visual verification: in the UPSTAIRS room editor of the Open Loft, the room-area caption pill must render (it was ground-only). (The ContextMenu room-heading fix in the same commit is NOT covered here — the menu does not open in the room editor; it is covered by code reading only.)

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: load-loft-plan
steps.eval: (function(){ window.__loadErr=null; import('/src/floorplan/templates.ts').then(m => { const plan = m.PLAN_TEMPLATES.find(p => p.id === 'tpl-loft'); if (!plan) throw new Error('tpl-loft missing'); window.__store.getState().replaceFloorPlan(plan, { furniture: 'rehome' }); }).catch(e => { window.__loadErr = String(e); }); })()

steps.name: put-furniture-on-the-loft
steps.eval: (() => { const s=window.__store.getState(); const its=s.items; const picks=its.slice(0,4).map(i=>i.id); const set=new Set(picks); s.setItems(its.map(it => set.has(it.id) ? { ...it, levelId:'lf-up', position:[1.0+picks.indexOf(it.id)*0.6, 4.2] } : it)); })()

steps.name: measurements-on
steps.eval: (() => { const s=window.__store.getState(); if (!s.showMeasurements) s.toggleMeasurements ? s.toggleMeasurements() : s.setShowMeasurements?.(true); })()

steps.name: assert-area-caption-rendered
steps.eval: (function(){ const el=document.querySelector('.room-editor-caption'); if(!el) throw new Error('the room-area caption did not render for an UPSTAIRS room — RoomEditorCaption looked the room up in plan.rooms (ground only)'); const txt=(el.textContent||'').trim(); if(!/Area:/.test(txt)) throw new Error('caption present but has no area: '+txt); if(/\b0(\.0+)?\s*m/.test(txt)) throw new Error('caption shows a zero area: '+txt); window.__captionText=txt; })()
